name: game-interface-design
description: Mobile-web game planning, player flows, HUDs, game feel, optional Figma UI, FSD/ECS Three.js greybox prototypes, lint-gated pixel sprite animation, and lifelike cat behavior with a trace check.

interface.shortDescription: Plan games, build Three.js prototypes, animate pixel sprites
interface.longDescription: Plan meaningful play, failure and replay, HUDs, game feel and business hypotheses; optionally produce editable Figma game UI; then turn the plan into a local Three.js prototype whose rules run in a headless ECS inside an FSD page slice, with typecheck, Steiger, headless, build and browser verification. Animate pixel sprites from a base frame plus diffs, gated by palette, phase, timing, smear and hit-feel lint with a contact-sheet review. Make a 2D or 2.5D cat move and react like a real cat, from idle life to petting warnings, toy play and startle, built from real-cat references and checked by a behavior-trace script.
defaultPrompt: Design a one-handed mobile web game from its core decisions through player flows and a testable handoff.
Build a playable Three.js greybox of the approved game plan with its rules in a headless ECS.
Animate a 32x32 player sword slash as pixel art with anticipation, smear and hitstop, passing the sprite lint.
